# Integrations and consumers

These rows grade each surface on dimensions that are deliberately not inferable from each other. `pre_action_enforcement` says how far a payment is actually stopped before it is signed: `none` means no enforcement was observed, `experimental` means something runs the integration but no gated payment was proven through it, and `tested` means a test or run we can point at. `receipt_support` is the strongest receipt path proven, and only moves `none` → `local` → `hosted_execution` → `settlement` when evidence for that exact step exists — a settlement is never inferred from an execution receipt. `host_version_tested` is the exact host version, or `unknown`. `proof_class` names the kind of artifact behind the row. `last_verified_at` is the date of that artifact, or `unknown` when nothing was verified. `evidence_ref` is a repo path or https URL a reviewer can open, or `unknown`. We do not infer enforcement from an example, deployment from a local test, or settlement from an execution receipt; when evidence is missing the value stays unknown rather than becoming a guess. When a known `last_verified_at` is more than 90 days old, `node scripts/gen-integrations.mjs --check` fails and names the row.

**12 rows · 12 with evidence · 6 carrying an unknown · 0 with no evidence.**

The seller-side pairing page is [PayMCP](paymcp.md); it stays prose and is linked from the PayMCP row below.

## Notes

- **MCP hosts (Claude Code, Cursor, Claude Desktop)** — Re-ran 2026-11-21: the stdio handshake against the published package proved initialize and tools/list (10 tools). No named host was driven and no payment was gated, so enforcement is none and the host version is unknown. The Claude Desktop, Cursor and Claude Code snippets are documented in README.md only.
- **AI SDK** — Ran 2026-11-21 (5 tests pass). The tests call the generated tool execute() functions directly, which is what a model would trigger; no model loop is driven. Host version is the installed ai 6.0.332; an enforcement test exists, not a full agent run.
- **elizaOS** — Ran 2026-11-21 (5 tests pass). The action handler is driven with a fabricated agent message, so the enforcement point is tested; no elizaOS runtime is installed or started, so the host version is unknown.
- **n8n** — Ran 2026-11-21 (3 tests pass). The node is driven through a fake n8n execution context and a stubbed HTTP helper; the hosted endpoint it calls is not contacted. No n8n package is installed, so the host version is unknown.
- **@x402/core** — Ran 2026-11-21 (37 tests in the package pass). A real @x402/core client is driven with a throwaway key; the allowed case produces a signed payload, and the denied case aborts before anything is signed.
- **@x402/evm** — Ran 2026-11-21 (37 tests in the package pass). ExactEvmScheme from @x402/evm signs only after the hook returns pay. The throwaway key is never funded, so this is not an on-chain payment and not a settlement.
- **x402-fetch (v1, unscoped)** — Ran 2026-11-21. The test loads the optional peer and proves the no-peer message is not raised, but the signed-payment path is delegated to x402-fetch and is stubbed; nothing here proves a gated payment end to end. Graded experimental, not tested: the peer runs, the enforcement through it is unproven.
- **PayMCP** — Prose pairing only: the page maps PayMCP's documented 402 challenge to the evaluator input. No PayMCP server was run and no payment was made, so enforcement is none and the host version is unknown. Their API may move.
- **Glama** — Last successful probe 2026-11-20 found all 10 tool names. On 2026-11-21 the probe failed to fetch the page, so the date stays at the last success and the page version is unknown; this is not evidence that the page changed.
- **mcp.so** — Live probe on 2026-11-21 found 3 of 10 tool names. The page is stale; updating it is the directory's crawl, not a repo change. A listing that is behind still does not gate a payment.
- **npm — @paystage/mcp** — Live probe on 2026-11-21: published version 0.8.17 matches the local package. A listing does not gate a payment, so pre-action enforcement is none even though the listing is current.
- **Official MCP registry** — Live probe on 2026-11-21: the registry entry resolves 0.8.17 and is aligned with the local package. It was behind at 0.8.15 on 2026-11-20; the republish has since landed.
